email.body1:
Jay, saw NetBrain launched Agentic NetOps with autonomous diagnosis agents, the first big release under your new CEO.

A platform shift like that usually opens more expansion and in-market accounts than the team can work, and reps end up buried in research instead of conversations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for NetBrain off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jay, quick follow-up for NetBrain.

With Agentic NetOps reframing the pitch and renewals to protect, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover expansion and retention together. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings NetBrain needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jay, last bit of proof for NetBrain.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NetBrain's reply rate likely compares to other network-software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jay, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A new CEO and a major platform release keep a sales team plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to NetBrain either way.
